newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end thin bourse session lower.
newsitem.headline: German shares end thin bourse session lower.

text.p: 1147 GMT - German shares end a thinly-traded bourse session lower, still undermined by Wall Street's overnight weakness and uncertainty ahead of U.S. job figures. Some resilience provided by stable dollar/mark, but with absence of corporate news no near-term gains seen.
* DAX ends bourse 12.54 points lower at 2,517.00, with IBIS all-day trade index also lower at 2,516.83
* Volumes limited ahead of U.S. payrolls and jobless data due 1230 GMT, seen as possible cue for U.S. rate hike
* Dollar trades at 1.4850/55 marks at 1145 GMT, barely changed from late Thursday's level in Europe.
